subject: Recap: data handling & next steps — ClearWave pilot
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: data handling & next steps — ClearWave pilot

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Pilot scope: NLP-powered clinical triage for two outpatient clinics (test/qa traffic only).
- Data flow: ClearWave will route de-identified encounter text to Redwood API in a VPC connection.
- Privacy ask: ClearWave requested that Redwood NOT use any pilot data to further train or fine-tune models (no model learning / tuning).
- Logs & retention: you indicated logs used for debugging are acceptable but would like them deleted after 14 days and stored only in the US region.
- Compliance artifacts: you asked for a signed confirmation we will exclude your data from model improvement, and a DPA addendum.

Next steps (suggested):
1) I’ll generate a formal, short confirmation doc that states: no training on customer data, logs retained 14 days, storage in US region; we’ll add that to the account record and attach the signed DPA.
2) Laura — looping you for the formal language and to confirm any additional legal ops steps.
3) Priya — if that summary matches your ask, can you confirm in reply and attach the signed DPA (or tell me who will sign)?

Attachments: [Attachment: 20270930-postcall-notes.txt (text)]

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber | Enterprise Sales

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the items below: 

- ClearWave requests that any pilot or production traffic from our clinics NOT be used to train or improve Redwood models. We need this to be explicit in writing.
- Logs for troubleshooting are OK but must be retained no longer than 14 days and stored in the US (we prefer us-east).
- We will sign a DPA addendum. I’ve attached the DPA with our signature placeholder initialed; legal will finalize signature tomorrow.

We’re ready to move forward once we have your formal confirmation doc and the DPA executed.

Thanks for the confirmation, Priya. A couple of quick clarifying items from ops/legal before we produce the formal acknowledgement: 

- Can you confirm the exact storage region you prefer ("us-east-1" or "us-west-2")? We can bind logs to region and note it in the account configuration.

If helpful, I’m happy to draft the exact one-paragraph acknowledgement language and attach it to the DPA.

- Debug logs will be stored in us-east-1 and automatically deleted after 14 days.
- Customer is responsible for providing de-identified payloads; Redwood will not perform PHI/PII redaction unless a separate scope and SOW is agreed.
- Once you provide the fully executed DPA we will countersign and attach the signed acknowledgement to the account folder.

Attachments: [Attachment: clearwave-data-exclusion-ack.pdf (PDF)]
